excluded_cameras.title: Excluded cameras
excluded_cameras.description: Exact camera IDs whose motion notifications, live previews and completed clips are ignored by this plugin. Recording and detection on the Frigate server are unchanged. Leave empty to include every camera.

mqtt_host.title: MQTT broker host
mqtt_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the broker used by Frigate.

mqtt_tls.title: Use TLS
mqtt_tls.description: Require a server certificate trusted by the worker's TLS roots.

mqtt_topic.title: Frigate events topic
mqtt_topic.description: One exact topic; MQTT wildcard subscriptions are not supported.

frigate_base_url.title: Frigate HTTP address
frigate_base_url.description: Optional direct HTTP(S) address for a 15-second live preview on motion, including any port or path prefix. Leave blank for notifications only. Credentials, queries and fragments are not supported.
